quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge ahead at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow for trucks.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow for trucks.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic must go only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic must go only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic can move.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross safely. Pay attention to pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road crossing ahead will create an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on a bridge over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road will cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive at to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are poor. Always slow down in bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows which direction you must drive on this street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one lane. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right and then left.
The road curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a winding road with three or more curves is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow to the speed shown.
A divided highway begins. Slow to the speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow to the speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow to the speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road meets from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road meets from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey them. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means you cannot do that action. This sign means no U-turns.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when they don't have turn signals. Left arm bent up at the elbow means the rider is turning right or moving right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Prepare for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows bicycles cross or ride in this area. Drive carefully and watch for bicycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other traffic pass. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black marks. This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black marks. This sign warns you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and cars with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be ready for vehicles coming from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a steep downhill section is coming. Slow down to avoid damaging your brakes or losing control.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it for passing other cars or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that you are about to enter a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points with one finger?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: This hand signal tells the group to form a single-file line. Hand signals help riders communicate while riding together.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely. Go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive at the posted speed.
The fastest you can drive is 55 mph.
You must drive at this speed through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest you can drive is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: To show a right turn, bend your left arm at the elbow and point upward. This tells others you are turning right or moving right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: To show a left turn, extend your left arm straight out to the side. This tells others you are turning left or moving left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you what is coming up. This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This is a triangular yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: From bottom to top, the traffic light colors in order are:
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights go green, yellow, then red.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: In group riding, hand signals help riders talk to each other. When the lead rider holds their left arm out with palm up and swings it upward, it means increase your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a sharp right turn coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when group riding?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate while in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What should worry you most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may misalign because one side of your car is higher than the other.
A tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your vehicle may hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn the wheel sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop and let other traffic pass. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you a curve in the road is coming.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down in wet conditions. Avoid sudden braking or sharp turns. Keep more distance between your vehicle and the one in front of you.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people entering the crosswalk or crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. Drivers must obey these signs. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers:

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane on a multi-lane road is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at a low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This sign means that:

options.text: A community group is cleaning up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that traffic is coming from both directions.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to avoid heavy traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: If there is no one in the next lane, move over to make room for traffic entering the freeway.

questions.question: This sign is used to prevent:

options.text: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. This could cause a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Get ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after stopping completely.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they must obey the law. Right turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must stop completely and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to pass before going forward.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out straight with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Only yield to traffic on the right.
Only yield to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road ahead has low clearance. Watch your vehicle's height.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and let others go.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Hiking trails are to the right.
A hotel is to the right.
A hospital is to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic from the right is about to merge. Be prepared to allow these vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge or overpass ahead is low. Check your vehicle's height before passing under it.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge or overpass ahead is low. Check your vehicle's height before passing under it.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can either continue forward or exit from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue forward.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane does not continue forward. The lane ends and becomes an exit ramp. You can change lanes to go forward, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Be ready for crossing traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Be ready for crossing traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic from the side roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for train signals and listen for trains.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the driver or rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for workers with flags.
Road work or maintenance is happening ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening ahead.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction and maintenance work. This sign tells you work is ahead. Slow down and drive with extra caution in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Be ready to slow down or stop for children.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert drivers to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet. Your vehicle will be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that controls traffic. It tells drivers they cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will make a sharp turn to the right and then a sharp turn to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a complete stop, then go if it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always make a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and shared vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is coming up. Be ready to slow down or stop for pedestrians.
